During the [[New Republic Era]], a '''youngling''' dwelled on the isolated [[planet]] [[At Achrann]], one of the [[Jewels of the Old Republic]]. The youngster was a [[Color|pale]]-skinned [[human]] with long, gray [[hair]] combed back, sporting a beige [[Clothing|poncho]] with a dark scarf around the neck.<ref name="Can't Say" />

Some time around [[9 ABY]],<ref>{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> the [[Youngling|child]] sat outside a shanty home beside their [[Unidentified human youngling 1|peer]] and watched from afar as [[Foodstuff|food]] was doled out to the off-worlder [[Neel]] and other local individuals. Neel quickly noticed the younglings and approached them, asking whether they were hungry and suggesting that they take his ration. The youngsters exchanged surprised looks and eventually accepted the offer.<ref name="Can't Say" />
